mcp_tracker_search_tasks() {
  local count=0
  local cursor=0
  
  while true; do
    # Call the search function with status=todo
    response=$(mcp__tracker__search_tasks --status "todo" --cursor "$cursor" 2>/dev/null)
    
    # Extract task count from this page
    page_count=$(echo "$response" | grep -c '"id"' || echo 0)
    count=$((count + page_count))
    
    # Check if there's a next cursor
    next_cursor=$(echo "$response" | grep -o '"next_cursor":[0-9]*' | grep -o '[0-9]*' || echo "")
    
    if [ -z "$next_cursor" ] || [ "$next_cursor" = "0" ]; then
      break
    fi
    
    cursor="$next_cursor"
  done
  
  echo "$count"
}

input.description: Search for all tasks in 'todo' status and count them
input.prompt: Use the mcp__tracker__search_tasks tool to find all tasks across all projects with status="todo". Handle pagination by starting at cursor=0 and continuing until there are no more results. Count the total number of tasks found and return just the count as a single digit/number.
